patterns.note: Content is primarily presented in a single-column, center-aligned layout, with occasional two-column splits for illustrative diagrams or product details.
Section headings are consistently oversized, bold, and uppercase, rendered in a vibrant red, creating a strong visual hierarchy and editorial feel.
A high-contrast color palette of pure white backgrounds, black body text, and a striking red for all major headings and call-to-action elements is used throughout.
The header navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
Content sections reveal themselves with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
Detailed content is organized into an accordion-style list at the bottom of the page, allowing users to expand specific topics.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-width, looping video background (the '66 PAGES' graphic) with large, bold, uppercase text overlaid, creating a dynamic and impactful first impression.
Typography is characterized by a display-heavy font for all major headings, rendered in a striking red and uppercase, contrasting sharply with a clear, readable sans-serif for body text.

Sections are revealed with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing content flow and engagement, likely using CSS keyframes. The top navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the screen during scroll.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, bold, uppercase display headings (~4-5x body) with smaller, clear sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.spacing: airy hero and section breaks, balanced within content blocks.

standout: The aggressive, oversized, uppercase red typography combined with a stark black and white palette creates an extremely bold and editorial aesthetic that feels more like a magazine spread than a typical landing page. The animated '66 PAGES' graphic further reinforces this distinctive, high-impact visual style.
